programme.title: Dhol
programme.desc: Four young loafers wish to simplify their life by wooing a loaded heiress. Unfortunately, there's only one rich girl in the neighbourhood. The boys scamper to woo her first, not knowing that their efforts would lead them right into a murder mystery.

programme.title: Black Friday
programme.desc: After the 1993 Mumbai bomb blasts rip the city apart, the police force launches a massive drive to catch the perpetrators. Their relentless pressure finally results in some names coming forward.

programme.title: Phir Hera Pheri
programme.desc: The lives of three men changes overnight when they lose all the money they invested in a scam. Now, they must find another way to repay the dreaded loan sharks or face their death.

programme.title: The Stoneman Murders
programme.desc: Mumbai of 1980s is terrorised by a serial killer who ruthlessly kills pavement dwellers in their sleep. A suspended police officer then decides to step in and conduct an investigation.

programme.desc: Aarush, Al and Tanmay, three womanisers get the shock of their life when they find a baby girl at their doorstep claiming to be the daughter of one of them. As they try to find her mother, they discover an unexplored side of their own personality.
